answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 36639 Country: India Title: Is attending a nikah/walimah haram if there is any sinful activity (like Jode ki raqam, photo video, phool ka haar) or there is more spending money on the dawat Question: Is attending a nikah/walimah haram if there is any sinful activity (like Jode ki raqam, photo video, phool ka haar) or there is more spending money on the dawat. Please let me know. Answer ID: 36639 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 275/L=180/TL=1433) If any walimah or party involves dance, song, mixing of men and women, photography or videography etc or the feast is held for pride, then it is not right to participate in such party. وأما الأعذار التى يسقط بها وجوب اجابة الدعوة أو ندبها فمنها ........أو يدعوه لخوف شره أو لطمع فى جاهه أو ليعاونه على باطل أو أن لا يكون هناك منكر من خمر أو لهوأ وفرض حريرأ و صور حيوان غير مفروشة (حاشية مسلم للنووى : 1/462) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
